metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in `/workspace/output` as a dependency-free Rust 2021 Cargo binary.

Files of interest:
- [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml)
- [build.rs](/workspace/output/build.rs)
- [src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)
- [src/app.rs](/workspace/output/src/app.rs)
- [src/iso2709.rs](/workspace/output/src/iso2709.rs)
- [src/xml.rs](/workspace/output/src/xml.rs)
- [src/validator.rs](/workspace/output/src/validator.rs)

What it does:
- Inspects ISO 2709 MARC records from base64 request input and emits normalized canonical JSON.
- Inspects MARCXML `<record>` or single-record `<collection>` input and emits the same canonical JSON.
- Renders canonical records back to ISO 2709 bytes or MARCXML.
- Rejects malformed requests and malformed records with structured errors and the required exit codes.
- Enforces UTF-8 payload decoding, ASCII structural bytes, MARC leader rules, field repeatability, indicator values, and subfield code constraints from the local `docs/` corpus.
- Keeps runtime self-contained by compiling the MARC rule table at build time into the binary.

Verified:
- `cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml`
- ISO 2709 render/inspect round-trip
- MARCXML render/inspect round-trip
- Rejection of invalid render input with extra JSON fields
